comment: Quest registry. Each entry: {file, summary, owner (Rosie|Steve|both)}. Quests are loaded by lib/quests.js on bot spawn and evaluated against player events + a 1s tick.

welcome_to_the_village.summary: When a kid joins, Rosie greets them and walks them through building 3 village structures together (house → well → garden).

treasure_at_the_tower.summary: When a kid chats 'treasure' or 'gold', Rosie builds a small tower nearby and gifts a golden apple after they reach the base.

find_the_treasure.summary: Steve-led treasure hunt. Kid says 'treasure hunt', Steve builds a campfire 15 blocks east, drops hints, and gifts a golden apple on arrival.
